label: Pole Row Crossing
text: A farm road lined with utility poles, and a vending machine that glows all night.

label: Two taps at dusk
text: People tap a utility pole twice before crossing the road at dusk, once for themselves and once for the next walker.

label: Hana
text: Keeps the vegetable plot by the third pole and knows every truck by its sound.

label: Breakwater Steps
text: Concrete steps down to the breakwater, with a fish-drying rack beside a tin-roofed house.

label: A shell on the top step
text: Whoever passes leaves one shell on the top step, the way people inland tap the poles twice.

label: Kei
text: Puts back every shell the tide takes, and keeps count out loud.

label: Unmanned Station
text: A single platform on the one-track line, and a bus stop sign nobody moved when the route changed.

label: A bow to the empty bench
text: Travellers bow to the empty bench before they sit; up here the shell left on the steps became a greeting.

label: Yuki
text: Waits for the last train every night and asks everyone about the tide.

label: Lost-and-Found Shelter
text: A bus shelter with a wooden shelf where forgotten things wait to be claimed.

label: A tag for every thing
text: Anything found near the shelter gets a paper tag with the finder's name, the way a pole gets two taps before the crossing.

label: Nobu
text: Runs errands for Chie and finds more lost things than anyone has lost.
